prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

Slavic woman, a fair porcelain complexion with a cool undertone, early 50s silver fox goddess, BBW bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — most massive full-figure BBW body ever at absolute maximum in every dimension, hips so wide beyond proportion dominating the entire frame, bust so enormous overwhelming gravity, waist deeply snatched despite impossible volume, silver-white chin-length bob — full body stained glass covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle, both legs FULLY covered to ankles — this is solid thick glass fused directly to her form, made of hundreds of small individual panes each no larger than a coin, densely packed edge to edge in an irregular cathedral-window mosaic, the panes small and numerous across her whole body, each tiny pane curving to follow her body's true shape with real physical thickness, dark lead-line seams webbing between every one of the hundreds of panes, each seam standing in a small raised ridge casting its own shadow. BLAZING ELECTRIC EMERALD and VIVID GOLD panes alternating in a dense irregular mosaic across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, no two adjacent panes quite the same shade, bright light passing through each tiny pane individually with sharp refraction glints, every mark crisp and hand-made with clean defined edges. A faint streak of soot crosses her cheekbone, and a little grime darkens her fingertips and the soles of her bare feet. Her expression is a still, steady expression. Restraints: She holds a huge rough-cast black iron ball as big as a bowling ball above her head in both hands, her arms raised straight up and trembling under its weight. Her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring linked by a short heavy chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, down and outward to its own huge black iron ring set in the flagstone floor on its own side. Pose: standing full height, facing the camera, her arms raised straight up holding the iron ball above her head, her elbows trembling, her head tilted slightly back under the weight, her bare feet spread about shoulder-width apart flat on the flagstones, her whole body straining, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.
Footwear: bare feet flat on the flagstones, with a little soot on the soles and toes. extra long stiletto nails to match.

Background: a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight, dim torchlight and flickering firelight raking across her from one side. A single woman fills the frame. Pattern density MAXIMUM — the pattern wraps her entire body from neck to ankle. Extreme high-gloss oil. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait. portrait 2:3 vertical.
